selection_policy: Confirmed correctness/readability defects first, then measured encounter problems, existing asset integration, canon alignment, and evidence-led visual review. Prefer one feasible entry per run; notices alone are not proven defects.

audit.checks: Baseline tools/check.sh passed: 2 documented drift warnings and 16 art-review notices.

workflow.choose: Read current default branch, applicable instructions and all relevant open PRs. Reconcile the latest queue revision from default and bestiary PRs. Select the lowest-rank unblocked pending task with current evidence.
workflow.complete: Implement exactly one entry refinement or verified visual pass; validate, create one review PR, and record results. Completed means delivered for review, not merged.
workflow.replenish: When no actionable pending tasks remain, inspect the whole current bestiary again and increment generation. Retain completed history and blocked items, deduplicate against open PRs, and add only concrete evidence-backed tasks. Do not recreate completed work unless fresh evidence warrants it.
workflow.blocked: Record the exact blocker and continue to the next feasible independent task. If no task can be completed, report it honestly; never count a proposal as a finished refinement.
workflow.delivery: Use a dedicated branch from current default; never merge or enable auto-merge. Carry the newest queue state forward without copying unrelated unmerged code. Use draft PRs when required validation remains incomplete.

tasks.title: Reveal Grab immediately after a three-character rescue
evidence: index.html: releaseAll clears captives but leaves the holding-only plan intact. Reproduced: Next: Savour after rescue, then Grab executes.
Both phases and both holding actions affected; no open bestiary PR duplicates this.
acceptance: Immediately show and log Grab after the third distinct taste.
Keep first/second/repeated tastes from changing the current plan.
Preserve late Stress targeting, release recovery, probabilities and battle outcomes.
Run a live-script regression, browser rendering check and repository checks.

validation.simulations: 900 before and 900 after; all seeded summaries identical
validation.browser: blocked: Chromium socket() Operation not permitted
validation.remaining: Browser visual verification before ready-for-review promotion; no merge performed.

Keep a viable fallback, record tradeoffs, update spec/status/reference and 200-run baseline; browser-play the result.
